attorneys: Jacob W. Friedman for petitioner., Solicitor General Perlman, Robert S. Erdahl and Philip R. Monahan for the United States.

opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. Certiorari granted limited to question “3” presented by the petition for the writ, i. e., whether it was prejudicial and reversible error for the trial court to receive in evidence, over objection, important alleged declarations of a co-conspirator after the termination of the alleged conspiracy and not in furtherance thereof.
